answer: tools/marketplace/dependency.py stores required/optional/peer/dev edges with version ranges and runs an iterative Johnson-style simple-cycle detector at publish. Planted self / two-node / four-node cycles report the exact closed path; an acyclic diamond is silent. graphlib.TopologicalSorter plus Kosaraju SCC agree on existence and membership. Peer-only mutual edges are classified and are not install cycles. A naive recursive walker still RecursionError's as the dead control. SUCCESS:IMP-0082

artifacts.note: self; sha256 is in the per-unit UNIT-ARTIFACT-MANIFEST.json row

evidence.claim: The primary detector reports the exact closed node sequence of a self-cycle, a two-node cycle, and a four-node cycle, and is silent on an acyclic diamond. The refuse happens at publish (DependencyCycleError.stage=publish), not as RecursionError at install.

stdlib graphlib.TopologicalSorter plus an independent Kosaraju SCC pass, run over the same edge list, agree with the primary detector on cycle existence AND membership. optional/peer/dev stay classified distinctly from required.

evidence_requirement: TWO independent signals: (1) the detector reports the exact node sequence of a planted cycle; (2) an independent graph library run over the same edge list reports the same cycle set. Agreement on existence AND on membership is required.

manifest_registration.note: per-unit manifest only; did not run tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --write

negative_controls.bad_state_output: a cyclic graph would have been reported
negative_controls.description: root→left, root→right, left→leaf, right→leaf. Must not be reported as a cycle by the primary detector or graphlib.

notes: G-1 for IMP-0082: live named probes re-run planted sequences and independent graphlib agreement. Cycle gate is publish-time via check_at_publish / index_linter DEPENDENCY_CYCLE. Did not run global unit_manifest.py --write. cloud_ok=true is not delivery. SUCCESS:IMP-0082
question_or_target: Model declared dependencies (required, optional, peer, dev) with version ranges and detect cycles at publish time, reporting the exact cycle path rather than failing with a recursion error at install time.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0070 owns range resolution; this unit stores and classifies ranges without solving them. Version-aware cycles across multiple releases of one name are deferred to IMP-0083's resolver.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 is graphlib.TopologicalSorter + Kosaraju SCC over the same edge list, a different method from probe 1's planted-path oracle. Publish-time gate confirmed: check_at_publish raises DependencyCycleError(stage='publish'); index_linter emits DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with the exact path a -> b -> a.

reviewer_requirement: Reviewer must confirm cycle detection runs at publish time, not only at install time.
